The issues raised include rudeness, unhelpfulness, impedance of services, failure to follow GP instructions, and potential medication errors. These issues, if substantiated, can significantly impact patient care and well-being.

The phlobotemist and some long practice nurses are excellent.

The administrative staff are the worst for being rude and unhelpful, and for impeding services. Failing to answer phone calls, promptly, or at all after the 8:30 rush, not responding to emails, or providing unclear or misleading information. They often try to pass on test results as normal when they are not at all normal and indicated treatment required. They delay appointments, test results, and access to necessary care. They act as if they are stoned over daily from the Miner’s drugs. In short they lack the required empathy: showing a lack of understanding or compassion for patients' concerns, especially when they are feeling vulnerable or unwell. This can exacerbate patient anxiety and distress.

These issues can violate the principles of the NHS Constitution, which emphasizes the importance of treating patients with dignity and respect, providing timely access to services, and ensuring effective communication.

In my experience,  the pharmacist failed to dispense medication or arrange for necessary tests, which may have led to the condition worsening, leading to more serious health problems had I not intervened & persisted- itself very difficult to do with unwilling adversaries. A pharmacist has a professional duty of care to ensure that patients receive the correct medication and advice. Failing to follow GP instructions may constitute a breach of this duty.

A newer nurse technician had  prescribed incorrect medication, according to the pharmacist, indicating a lack of Training or Competency. Incorrectly prescribed medication can lead to adverse drug reactions, ineffective treatment, or other serious health problems.

Manor Surgery leaves patients ‘praying for miracles’",null,[0,239]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25sSFJVUkxSbXhvUzFSelRUVndMV0ZKWldKbFJsRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x6c19381beccc2cdc!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOnlHRURLRmxoS1RzTTVwLWFJZWJlRlE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25sSFJVUkxSbXhvUzFSelRUVndMV0ZKWldKbFJsRRAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwjyp7Gfw6-TAxULEWMBHQx8BlQQoykICigB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwjyp7Gfw6-TAxULEWMBHQx8BlQQ0pMFCAgoAg"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBeHBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEZGZURUkzZEVaZlgxOWZSV2hCTW1OUFZrTlFjamhuYVMwMlpURk5kMEZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpvTUVOYU9EQXdPVmd3V1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VOak84WmJIN2VYTFVBEAE",["0x0:0x6c19381beccc2cdc",null,1748422421947091,1748422421947091,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/105235921680386619457/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Nicole Roberts","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLVg7mTFo0rSoZ6nDjAJ-saA39mWe0dmH2RLId6gnc1KGuiWHw=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/105235921680386619457?hl=en"],"105235921680386619457",null,8,1,null,[0,3,1],0,["8 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwjyp7Gfw6-TAxULEWMBHQx8BlQQ7LoGCAwoAA"]]]],null,"9 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[2],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["No complaints about the doctors or nurses themselves however the receptionist they have at the moment is extremely rude spoke on the phone and was constantly interrupted asked why I’d waited so long to book an appointment told that I needed to change my address from my mums and told me that I may get kicked off when I change the address. I have been with the surgery all my life and they are coping so well with the constantly increasing pressure and demands. The klinik system works brilliantly, triaging the most clinically severe cases first and making sure those who are sickest get the help they need and are a priority. The reception staff are very helpful assisting those without internet access and filling out the forms on their behalf. Definitely a much better system than phoning multiple times on the day to try and get an appointment. My prescription requests are always processed very quickly and accurately.

The reception staff are always friendly, welcoming and very helpful. The doctors are outstanding. I would especially like to thank Dr Simpson for her kindness and support when I was going through a hard time.
